tweets.text: I think only a few people know but you can turn on tmux-like double/triple click behaviour in Grok Build. Pretty useful when you need to copy a URL or a file path. Just add the following to ~/.grok/config.toml [ui] double_click_action = "word_select" word_separators = '''!"#$%&'()*+,:; = ?@[\]^`{|}'''
